[[File:BFH Commando.png|right|270px]]
The '''Commando''' is a class in ''[[Battlefield Heroes]]''. It is very similar to the [[Recon]] and [[Special Forces]] kits of other ''[[Battlefield series|Battlefield]]'' titles. The Commando has the choice of using a [[Knife/Heroes|Knife]], a [[Sniper Rifle#Battlefield Heroes|Sniper Rifle]], and a Pistol as main weapons. The Commando can use [[TNT#Battlefield Heroes|Sticky TNT]] or a grenade launcher as their explosive. They also have the unique ability to cloak themselves to become almost invisible. The Commando class can do the most damage per hit, and is the fastest of the infantry units (without using speed-up abilities). Despite this, it is the weakest class in damage, dealing only 80 hit points.

==Abilities==
The Commando Class has 6 abilities:
{| border="1" width="600" cellspacing="0" cellpadding="3" style="background: #252525; border:1px solid #7a7a7a; border-collapse:collapse;"
|-
|<center>[[File:Stealth.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Commando|Stealth]]: Cloaking from enemy view.
|-
|<center>[[File:Elixer.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Commando|Elixir]]: [[Sprint|Increases speed]] and defense for a short time.
|-
|<center>[[File:Mark target.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Commando|Mark Target]]: Receive points for [[Spotting#Battlefield Heroes|designating enemy targets]] for your team. Can reveal enemy Commandos using Stealth.
|-
|<center>[[File:Trap.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Commando|Troop Trap]]: Place an explosive that will trigger when enemies approach too close or when it is shot.
|-
|<center>[[File:Perzing shot.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Commando|Piercing Shot]]: Increase the damage done by [[Sniper Rifle#Battlefield Heroes|sniper rifles]].
|-
|<center>[[File:Poison.png]]</center>
|[[Abilities#Commando|Poisoned Blade]]: Damage from the [[Knife/Heroes|knife]] causes the victim to be poisoned, losing health over a period of time.
|}

==Trivia==
*The Commando has the most abilities out of any class in ''[[Battlefield Heroes]]'' with 6. The [[Gunner]] and [[Soldier]] Classes both have 5.
